headline.en: UNI's 8.77% weekly bounce is cosmetic — price sits 35% below the DAO's own $5.96 anchor while supply still grows +2.07%/year.
headline.zh: UNI 周涨 8.77% 属表面反弹;现价较 DAO 自身 $5.96 公允价值锚仍低 35%,供应仍以 +2.07%/年净通胀。

keyChanges.en: Net supply still expands by 18.5M UNI/year — $5.77M annualized buyback retires only ~1.5M UNI against 20M emission, offsetting just 7.5% of issuance.
keyChanges.zh: 净供应仍以 18.5M UNI/年扩张——年化 $5.77M 回购仅销毁约 1.5M UNI,对 20M/年排放的抵消率只有 7.5%。

keyChanges.en: Price $3.857 trades 35% below the DAO's $5.96 treasury burn anchor and at the upper edge of the $3-3.5 retail capitulation zone.
keyChanges.zh: $3.857 现价较 DAO 国库销毁隐含锚 $5.96 低 35%,正处 $3-3.5 散户投降区间上沿。

keyChanges.en: Derivatives are thin and one-sided: $20.68M OI is trivial for a $2.41B cap, funding flat at +0.01%, yet long/short ratio 1.92 signals crowded retail longs without institutional flow.
keyChanges.zh: 衍生品面薄且单边:$20.68M OI 相对 $2.41B 市值可忽略,funding rate 仅 +0.01%,但 long/short 比 1.92 显示散户单边多头拥挤、机构缺席。

contrarianObservation.en: The bearish supply thesis assumes v4 protocol fees never activate. The Temp Check is live on the forum — if v4 fees turn on at a similar 17% take, annualized buyback could 2-3x and flip net supply negative. That optionality is not priced at $3.85.
contrarianObservation.zh: 空头供应论点建立在 v4 协议费用不激活的前提上。相关 Temp Check 已在治理论坛推进——若 v4 按 17% 抽成开启,年化回购规模可能放大 2-3 倍并使净供应翻转为通缩,而这份期权在 $3.85 几乎未被定价。

watchNext.en: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees — voting outcome and any modeled revenue delta versus the current $33.96M annualized base.
watchNext.zh: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees 的投票结果,以及相对当前 $33.96M 年化收入基数的收入增量测算。

watchNext.en: Robinhood Chain fee expansion progression from Temp Check to on-chain governance vote.
watchNext.zh: Robinhood Chain 费用扩张提案从 Temp Check 推进到链上治理投票的节奏。

watchNext.en: Whether a real-yield redirect RFC returns to the forum — it is conspicuously absent from the top-5 active threads.
watchNext.zh: real-yield(实际收益)重定向 RFC 是否重新出现在论坛议程——目前在 Top 5 活跃帖中明显缺席。

fullReasoning.en: The 7-day +8.77% move is technical noise, not a regime shift. Price at $3.857 remains 35% below the DAO's own $5.96 treasury burn implied fair value and sits at the top of the $3-3.5 retail capitulation zone. The core problem is unchanged: $33.96M annualized protocol revenue funds only $5.77M of buybacks, retiring ~1.5M UNI/year against fixed 20M emission — supply still expands 2.07%/year. At this revenue level the burn narrative is arithmetically insufficient. Governance is quiet on the variable that actually matters: no real-yield redirect RFC is on the active agenda. What is live are fee-expansion Temp Checks (v4 protocol fees, Robinhood Chain) that, even if approved, take months to translate into revenue. Derivatives corroborate apathy — $20.68M OI is negligible for a $2.41B cap token, funding at +0.01% shows no leverage conviction, yet long/short 1.92 flags a crowded retail long. TVL fell 2.69% w/w and Unichain stalled at $27.53M — the L2 growth story is not compounding. UNI/ETH at 0.001969 looks compressed, but that is efficient pricing of a still-inflationary asset with a rising BTC-dominance backdrop. Directional bias bearish over 1-4 weeks unless the v4 fee vote genuinely accelerates.
fullReasoning.zh: 7 日 +8.77% 只是技术性噪音,并非格局切换。$3.857 现价较 DAO 自身 $5.96 的国库销毁隐含公允价仍低 35%,位于 $3-3.5 散户投降区间上沿。核心问题未变:年化协议收入 $33.96M 只能支撑 $5.77M 回购,以现价年化销毁约 1.5M UNI,相对 20M/年的固定排放,供应仍以 2.07%/年净通胀。当前收入水平下,销毁叙事在数学上不成立。治理层面真正关键的 real-yield(实际收益)重定向 RFC 不在议程上,论坛活跃的只有费用扩张类 Temp Check(v4 协议费用、Robinhood Chain),即便通过,转化为收入也需数月。衍生品面同样冷清:$20.68M OI(未平仓)对 $2.41B 市值代币可以忽略,funding rate(资金费率)+0.01% 显示没有杠杆信念,而 long/short 账户比 1.92 说明散户单边多头拥挤、机构缺席。TVL 周降 2.69%,Unichain TVL 停在 $27.53M——L2 增长故事没有复利。UNI/ETH 比价 0.001969 看似压缩,但这是市场对一个仍在净通胀资产的有效定价,且 BTC dominance 抬升的宏观背景并不利于山寨轮动。1-4 周方向偏空,除非 v4 费用投票真正加速。
